name: Magcrest
old_description: Magcrest is a leading flexible packaging manufacturer specializing in custom retail bags, multi-layer films, and innovative packaging solutions.
about:
Magcrest was founded in 1991 in Monsey, New York, as a supplier of retail bags. The company quickly expanded into multi-layer films and a full range of flexible packaging. It operates offices in New York with warehouses in New Jersey and California, serving customers worldwide.

Magcrest manufactures custom retail bags, premade pouches, roll stock, shrink labels, sleeves, and merchandise bags. Its printing capabilities include flexographic, rotogravure, digital, and offset processes up to ten colors. The company works with a wide range of single- and multi-layer plastic films, papers, and sustainable materials such as compostable PLA and biodegradable PE. Annual output reaches tens of millions of packages, with order volumes ranging from a single carton to 1,000 tons.

The company serves the food, cosmetics, retail, and industrial sectors, providing packaging that enhances shelf life and brand presentation. Clients include brands seeking fully custom packaging solutions, from design consultation through prototyping to global delivery.

Magcrest differentiates itself with a responsive team that typically returns calls within ten minutes, lead times as short as two weeks, and the ability to combine plate and digital printing. Its global sourcing network spans ten countries, and the company emphasizes integrity by refusing to poach satisfied customers and taking full responsibility for every order.
